header.title: Getting started
header.description: Install Gemffects, load the styles and wrap your UI with visual effects.

peers.title: Peers
peers.body: React 19. @gem-org/gem-system is optional: when installed, effects use its color tokens (--gem-*); otherwise they fall back to neutral values.

usage.title: Basic usage
usage.description: Each effect wraps its child. By default it renders a wrapping `div`, and every prop is optional.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: The quickest way: import styles.css once in your entry point and use the effects from the barrel.

partial.title: Import only what you need
partial.description: Each effect ships as its own subpath (kebab-case, for example @gem-org/gemffects/border-beam) with a matching stylesheet (border-beam.css). That way the bundle only includes the JS and CSS of the effects you actually use.
partial.label: Partial import

notes.tokens: Import tokens.css once: it defines the --gemfx-* duration, easing and intensity variables.
notes.aliases: Two stylesheets have aliases: holo-foil.css points to holofoil.css and tilt-3d.css to tilt3d.css.
notes.single: Pick one path: styles.css already includes every stylesheet, so don't mix it with individual imports.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild` the effect skips the wrapping `div` and merges its classes, variables and listeners onto the single child. Useful inside Flex or Grid, or on a real `button`. The child must be exactly one React element.

tokens.title: Motion tokens
tokens.description: Gemffects owns duration, easing and intensity. Palette, type, spacing and radius come from the host app (--gem-*).
tokens.intensity: `intensity` accepts a token (`sm`, `md` or `lg`) or a number between `0` and `1`. The tokens map to 35%, 55% and 80%.

a11y.title: Reduced motion and touch
a11y.description: Effects are meant to decorate, not to convey information.

items.reducedMotion: Every effect respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Use ignoreReducedMotion only when motion is essential to the experience.
items.decorative: Effect layers (halos, particles, waves) are aria-hidden and the child stays interactive.
items.touchPointer: Pointer-tracking effects (Tilt3D, Magnetic, Spotlight, HoloFoil, Zoom) ignore touch by default (disabledOnTouch is true).
items.touchGesture: Gesture and tap effects (Ripple, Flash, ParticleBurst, ParticleRain, Rip, RipZone) work on touch by default (disabledOnTouch is false).

code.particles: only for ParticleBurst, ParticleRain and Rip
